text.tspan: The chosen strategy runs locally every frame. Commentary lines
are written by the model during play
Odysseus' portrait and lives, top left.
Score, difficulty, time and pause, top right.
Objective and progress counters stay in view.
Rival card: plan name and current behaviour. Pilot: the plan
name and the live line can disagree.
Live from the voyage: the bard's and rival's lines appear
On-screen direction buttons for mouse and touch players.
Tactical cue strip with the current instruction.
